name: Feature or methodology proposal
about: Propose a benchmark scenario, evaluation method, or capability.
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Research question and user

What decision should this help evaluate, and who will use the result?

## Proposed method

Describe the scenarios, inputs, reference evidence, annotation approach, and intended outputs.

## Reproducibility and limitations

Explain run metadata, repeated-run requirements, likely sources of variation, and how the result could be checked independently.

## Dependencies and data rights

State provider requirements, expected API costs, source provenance, and redistribution constraints. Do not include credentials or private data.

## Acceptance criteria and alternatives

What would demonstrate that this works? What existing approach could address the same question?
